entities.summary: The Kakrail Mosque, also known as the Malwali Mosque or as the Kakrail Markaz, is a Tabligh Jamat mosque in the Kakrail neighbourhood of Ramna, Dhaka, Bangladesh. Located near Ramna Park, it is the centre of the Tabligh Jamat in Bangladesh.
